CV.neural_epoch_policy: source early stopping, maximum 400/patience 30/min_delta .0001, same-seed reinitialization and train-all refit for selected epoch

aggregation: average the two neural seeds within each fold; then five equally weighted folds (one test fold has 60 rather than 61 cases); do not pool/average across cohorts. SD is descriptive, not a confidence interval.
baseline_difference_from_historical: BLOCK_PCA_BUDGETED_K10: original 06b block-scaling/PCA mechanics, but primary budgets 5000/10000/5000 for this external task instead of all eligible features. Not the unchanged historical BLOCK_PCA row.
cohort: TCGA-KIRC; all 304 metadata-selected primary-tumor cases; no new case exclusions

endpoints.cross_view_MRR: exact 06b cross_view_mrr: train-scaled per-view embeddings, cosine test-to-test retrieval, six ordered directions, stable sample-index ties; raw and harmonic-null-adjusted clipped MRR
endpoints.neural_heldout_collapse: effective_rank(TEST patient_shared)<2 OR median(sample variance)<1e-4; flag not exclusion
endpoints.omitted_view_nmse: same molecular space/mask/null; target view unavailable to shared representation and private input set to zero; per-view then equal-view mean (lower better)
endpoints.reconstruction_nmse: per-view observed TEST entries in selected molecular-feature space standardized with TRAIN parameters; neural predictions inverse-projected from per-view PCA. MSE divided by TRAIN observed-feature-centered null MSE; floor 1e-12. Report raw NMSE and mean across views (lower better), not imputed targets.
endpoints.seed_only_subspace_agreement: canonical subspace agreement between the two same-fold neural TEST representations; five descriptive fold values. No resampling, no truth, no retention decision.

excluded_scope: no .60 retention validation or biological truth recovery on KIRC
no complete 80%-subsample stability or final full-cohort refit in this limited stage
failure: stop at first unexpected technical failure and preserve error; no seed/parameter rescue or successful-only primary average; previously completed records immutable
inference: paired descriptive differences only; no p-values or inferential intervals; folds share training observations
interpretation: independent-cohort fixed-procedure application, not zero-shot transfer of TARGET weights, not proof of general biological correctness. V4 denotes its representation engine BEFORE retention here.

V1_SHARED_PRIVATE_AE.prespecified_component_hypothesis: Shared/private decomposition separates cross-view structure from assay-specific variation.

V4_SABLE_MO.prespecified_component_hypothesis: The stability gate removes attractive but non-reproducible latent factors.

numerical_helper.policy: use unchanged prepared_views, evaluate_fixed_model, observed_nmse, loader and agreement functions

preprocessing.common_evaluation_features: same train-selected primary-budget features for all three models
preprocessing.early_stop_preprocessing: fit partition only; redo on outer train=fit+early for refit
preprocessing.variance: ddof=1, before z-score, strictly positive, stable original-index tiebreak

provenance_boundary.design_scope: fixed limited replication of SARC, not an untouched pre-SARC preregistration

real_execution_requires: separate exact-source authorization after this synthetic GPU report is reviewed
retrieval_candidate_count_policy: actual held-out n in each fold: 61,61,61,61,60; harmonic null H_n/n computed per n, never the SARC n=50 constant
selection: None. Report all three fixed models. Do not change TARGET V1 selection or 05e.
training_cap_boundary: 400 maximum epochs unchanged after SARC results; no claim of convergence; record every selected epoch/cap hit
